body:
## Bounded continued-reliance assessment

The revised proposal is unchanged since r3. This renewal assesses two changes in contextual basis only; it does not judge the new Release model's technical design or approve source deletion.

- System replaces the old unmodified-consumer example with the approved complete one-approval routine path: generated preparation, exact candidate-bound execution, public observation and durable reporting. It adds changed-candidate/duplicate-response/public-verification cases and preserves immutable candidate basis, separately persisted observations, independent adoption and publication boundaries. This expresses the already selected direction; it does not add a new proposal-level responsibility.
- The R7/R8 source notice retains protective proof obligations, existing applicability, aliases and freshness while allowing the separately selected coordination/timing changes and coordinated consumer adoption. Required operation facts remain mandatory; checks alone grant no publication authority. This reconciles the source notice with the proposal's explicit change from documentation-only consolidation.

Every other r3 basis identity, including the complete proposal, remains unchanged. Its complete direction/dimension assessment remains applicable below. No new material direction defect, vision conflict or necessary upstream decision was found. Whether the revised Release model fully realizes these constraints remains the independent Design reviewer's task. This review neither approves its exact technical choices nor relies on an anticipated clean Design judgment. Statements below that Design requires revision/reassessment describe the proposal's downstream requirement, not a claim that authorship has not now occurred.

R3 retains its exact original subjects, body and judgment; its applicability is restricted to stale because two recorded contextual identities changed. R4 records the renewed direction judgment against current identities rather than retargeting r3. Checks for this renewal: bounded Git diff inspection, identity comparison, primary CLI context and subject inspect, then targeted batch; no release, runtime, publication or implementation proof was executed. Scoped record validation follows the save.

## Result

- Skill: proposal-review
- Review status: approved
- Vision alignment: aligned
- Material findings: none
- Open blockers: none for the proposal-level decision.
- Proposal readiness: amended direction and embedded feasibility are sufficient for authorized Design revision.
- Immediate next stage: Design revision by its owner; this manual review stops after recording.
- Automatic downstream handoff: none.
- Claim limitations: this approves the revised direction only. It does not approve the existing Design against that revision, exact source/test deletion, implementation, execution proof, publication, customer installation, Verify or PR readiness.

## Review Dimensions

- Challenge: pass. Fragmented Release authority remains concrete; the new insufficiency is now a complete routine operator path rather than documentation arrangement alone. It does not claim every existing operation is manual or invent a measured maintenance cost.
- Goals: pass. A supported routine release of already-reviewed and merged work requires only one normal maintainer approval. Automatic preparation, necessary checks, publication, public observation and durable reporting remain explicit alongside the Release model and actual justified source removal. Setup and genuinely ambiguous decisions are bounded exceptions, not an accepted routine checklist.
- Scope: pass. Complete routine coordination and candidate-bound continuation are core; timing/evidence amendments and necessary consumers are dependencies. Other model transfers, a general workflow engine and hosted service remain separate. Actual release during this engineering initiative remains excluded without separate authorization; implementing publication capability is in scope. These are compatible boundaries.
- Governing principle: pass. The system performs and verifies the exact operation the maintainer approved and exposes real exceptions. It preserves the necessary information rather than rewarding file or check count reductions.
- Direction: pass. Approval binds source, release identity, contents, destinations and publication path. Material changes require renewed approval; stale/contradictory proof stops publication; unchanged rechecking need not multiply approvals. Duplicate/lost outcomes require external-state inspection and must not overwrite or substitute a conflicting artifact. Version, channel, release-note and recovery decisions are not silently invented.
- Feasibility: pass. Exactly one embedded Feasibility section gives a credible existing-mechanism basis and explicit remaining Design decisions. Inspected preparation and preflight wrappers delegate to existing profile/check functions; the tag-triggered workflow verifies and creates GitHub/npm outputs; public closeout has actual provider mode distinct from fixtures. These substantiate starting mechanisms only, not an existing candidate-bound complete path. Exact input sourcing, approval/execution binding, continuation and consumer contracts remain Design work. No new universal platform or actual public release is a prerequisite to assess the direction.
- Material impact: pass. Real automation and telemetry-policy changes are disclosed as revisions of the former source-only direction. Irreversible publication, required safety/evidence, retained exceptions, complete-path proof and unchanged independent gates remain visible. Existing timing-required behavior must be explicitly amended, not ignored.
- Vision alignment: pass, aligned. Durable inspectable authority and observed results improve traceability and resumability. Removing duplicated manual data entry and routine coordination does not replace engineers' approval or independent assessments. No autonomous merge/runtime platform or artifact-free process is selected.
- Downstream authority: pass. No exact public command, approval UI, schema, state implementation or delivery milestone is prematurely prescribed. Design owns precise approved policy changes and consumer interactions; Delivery allocates concrete proof. Existing Design reflects the former direction and must be revised and independently reassessed; its present mismatch is expected upstream sequencing, not a defect requiring this proposal to retain the old direction.
- Requested decision: pass. The decision explicitly selects the approval-driven path, exact candidate authority, automatically derived evidence, nonblocking duration telemetry, Release model and scoped source retirement. It expressly supersedes the old coordination exclusion while preserving publication permission boundaries.

## Scope Preservation Review

- Scope-preservation result: pass. The user's amended goals remain explicit: one normal approval; CLI/CI preparation/checking/publishing/observation/reporting; exact candidate binding and safe retry; missing timing nonblocking; no duplicated manual metadata/evidence entry; and the Release model plus justified source cleanup and safety. Existing profile/fixture/metadata consumers are preserved or deliberately reconciled, rather than deleted solely to reduce representations.
- Complete-path proof is a completion requirement. Separate helper passes or documentation-only checks cannot establish that the routine path works. Required examples cover prerequisite failure before approval, changed candidate after approval, duplicate/lost response, delayed visibility, public verification failure and unavailable timing. Safe substituted services do not become evidence of an actual public release.
- Standing release correctness facts remain mandatory; timing is isolated as duration telemetry. Unavailable/malformed telemetry must be reported honestly and may identify a tooling defect, without pretending a measurement exists or making public evidence optional.
- Other responsibility consolidation remains with existing FU-012/FU-013 ownership. No Distribution, Installation or general Validation model is implicitly added, and no historical source deletion is authorized solely because it lacks a model.

## Recommended Proposal Edits

- Recommended edits: none required.

## Recommendation

- Recommendation: approve the revised direction for Design. Amend the prior Design and exact timing/coordination owners before Delivery reliance. Do not treat former Design approval or helper availability as evidence that the new complete path is implemented.
- Evidence basis: complete amended proposal and user clarification; Constitution/Vision; System's Release responsibility and Design's source-retention policy; retained release-process/transaction requirements and ADR rationale; published-skill-first release composition; existing follow-up ownership. A bounded code inspection was triggered by the revised Feasibility claim that existing prepare/preflight/verification/tag-publication/public-closeout tools provide a starting point. The three wrappers, release workflow, release-verify entry boundary and release_transaction timing-validation function support that limited statement. No repository-wide dependency audit, full implementation review or current public-service behavior claim was needed for this direction assessment. No project-map reliance was used.
- Concrete implementation baseline: preparation/preflight currently print the next helper invocation; the tag workflow has separate publication jobs; missing required timing currently yields an error in validate_release_timing_evidence. The proposal correctly treats coordination and timing handling as changes requiring Design and implementation, not as existing conformance. Existing fixed release-target/approval mechanisms require inspection downstream; no guarantee of implementation adequacy is inferred.
- Prior findings: CLI context showed no active proposal finding or blocker. The earlier Design findings retain their separate recorded dispositions; this review neither changes them nor restores stale Design approval.
- Checks actually run: primary CLI context with explicit full selections; primary subject inspect with exact current identities; bounded source reads/searches and diff inspection; targeted review record. No release, public smoke, package build or runtime behavior test was executed. Structural record validation and diff hygiene are checked after recording and do not constitute engineering approval.

## Specialized-gate group

- Active gate predicates: scope_budget_context=true; vision_exception_context=false; standing_artifact_context=false.
- Gate outcomes: scope-budget pass. Added coordination, authorization and timing changes are explicitly classified; original cleanup remains core; unrelated models and actual publication remain separate. Scope expansion is openly user-selected rather than hidden in consumer corrections.
- Trigger ambiguity: none.

## Durable-recording group

- Recording status: recorded through targeted batch on successful save.
- Recording blocker: none.
- Record path: docs/changes/2026-09-09-release-model-source-consolidation/reviews/proposal-review-r4.json
- Finding-record paths: none.

## Formal-review group

- Review ID: proposal-review-r4
- Review record: docs/changes/2026-09-09-release-model-source-consolidation/reviews/proposal-review-r4.json
- Governed change identity: 2026-09-09-release-model-source-consolidation
- Invocation classification: formal-lifecycle/manual; PRR1G-recorded-context-gated.
- Independence: separate reviewer did not author or edit the amended proposal or engineering changes. Author remains release-model-proposal-author. This review writes only its assessment/applicability and preserves earlier judgments and stale applicability.
independence_basis: Separate independent reviewer agent did not author or edit the amended proposal or its engineering context; inspected the full revised proposal, existing direction basis and bounded operational mechanism evidence. Prior reviews do not substitute for this new direction judgment. Same independent reviewer inspected the two contextual amendments for continued proposal-direction reliance; did not author them and grants no Design approval.
